pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability delivery and verification readiness projection
pressure_hypothesis.title: Budgeted ECI hides provider readiness context for an excluded verification obligation
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Retain a bounded, provenance-linked verification executor and provider readiness relationship in the ECI evidence-priority response.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and selected-session ambient verification records

request.operation: trace an excluded external verification obligation to its exact provider binding and determine whether the compact ECI exposes checkout and toolchain readiness context

outcome.observed_limitation: The pre-change evidence-priority ECI summary omitted session_activity.capability_delivery.verification_executor_context, so the exact executor binding and related provider capability state were not available in the compact analysis response.
outcome.baseline_evidence: The pre-change live ECI query returned a budgeted summary without the verification executor relationship. Its response identity and digest were not retained, so this occurrence does not claim an immutable baseline projection artifact.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The verified verification record establishes an excluded outcome, not an environmental defect or a measured agent burden. Same-provider capability evidence does not establish a dependency or cause. The Btrfs incident is unrelated to this executor-readiness observation.

related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
